scripts.build: bun run --filter '*' build && bun run bundle:action
scripts.bundle:action: bun build packages/cli/src/main.ts --outfile dist/action.js --target node --format cjs --minify
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @heyo-sh/code-audit-core build && bun run --filter @heyo-sh/code-audit-core typecheck && bun run --filter @heyo-sh/code-audit-runtime-pi build && bun run --filter @heyo-sh/code-audit-runtime-pi typecheck && bun run --filter @heyo-sh/code-audit-reporter-github build && bun run --filter @heyo-sh/code-audit-reporter-github typecheck && bun run --filter @heyo-sh/heyo-code-audit build && bun run --filter @heyo-sh/heyo-code-audit typecheck
scripts.test:coverage: bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=text && bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter=lcov && node scripts/check-line-coverage.mjs
